newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's April electrical output rises 5.4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's April electrical output rises 5.4 percent.

text.p: Peru's electrical power output in April rose 5.4 percent to 1,385 gigawatt hours (GWh), compared with the same month last year, the Energy and Mines Ministry said Friday.
Total electrical power output in the first four months was up 3.0 percent to 5,524 gigawatt hours (GWh), compared with the same period last year.
Public service firms accounted for 1,148 GWh in April, while firms generating their own power produced the remaining 237 GWh of the country's total output.
State-run Electroperu, the largest of Peru's power- generating public service firms, produced 535 GWh in April, up 19 percent from the same month last year.
